note: Ordinance 2024-198, passed on final reading on 2024-10-08 (minutes at https://pasadenatx.gov/AgendaCenter/ViewFile/Minutes/_10082024-534), imposed a commercial moratorium on BESS permits. Its preamble, quoted in Ordinance 2025-001, says it would expire 90 days after adoption unless extended after notice and hearing. Ordinance 2025-001 extended it for a 90-day period past January 6, 2025, which ends on 2025-04-06; council passed it on first reading on 2025-01-06 and on second and final reading on 2025-01-07 (minutes 01062025-551 and 01072025-554). Before that end date, council adopted Ordinance 2025-082, adding Chapter 9, Article XII, Energy Storage Systems, to the Code of Ordinances (first reading 2025-03-18, second and final reading 2025-04-01), the regulations the moratorium was meant to give time to draft. Second reading (agent:blind-reviewer-1 (Claude Code, 2026-10-18), opened): Pasadena imposed a 90-day commercial moratorium on BESS permits on October 8, 2024 (Ordinance 2024-198, under Texas Local Government Code 212).
